Is the browser window narrower than a breakpoint?

Source: R/windowSize.R
window_is_narrow.Rd

Turns the reactive returned by window_size_server() into a single TRUE/FALSE that only changes when the window crosses breakpoint. Use it where a render only needs to know "narrow or wide", such as crukTable(mobile = is_narrow()), instead of reading the raw width.

Usage

window_is_narrow(win_size, breakpoint = 900)

Arguments

win_size

The reactive returned by window_size_server(). Pass the reactive itself (win_size), not its value (win_size()).

breakpoint

Single number. Window width in pixels below which the window counts as narrow. Default is 900 (Bootstrap's md breakpoint), which matches the default mobileBreakpoint of crukTable().

Value

A reactive expression returning TRUE if the window width is below breakpoint, otherwise FALSE. Call it with brackets: is_narrow().

Details

Reading win_size() inside a render function makes that output re-run on every window size update. Reading the result of window_is_narrow() instead only re-runs it when the value flips, so a table keeps its current page, sort order and selection while the window is resized within one band.

Call this once, in the server function (or module server), because it creates an observer. It does not change window_size_server(): that still returns the full width and height, so you can use both side by side.

The value is FALSE until the browser has reported a width, so the first render is the wide version. On a narrow window it flips to TRUE shortly afterwards (after the debounce_ms of window_size_server()) and the output re-runs once.

It returns only two states. For plots or tables that need to scale smoothly with the window, or that need the width in pixels, use win_size().

See also

window_size_server(), crukTable()

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
library(shiny)

ui <- fluidPage(
  crukTheme(),
  window_size_ui("window_tracker"),
  crukTableOutput("table")
)

server <- function(input, output, session) {
  win_size  <- window_size_server("window_tracker", debounce_ms = 300)
  is_narrow <- window_is_narrow(win_size, breakpoint = 900)

  output$table <- renderCrukTable(
    crukTable(mtcars, pagination = TRUE, mobile = is_narrow())
  )
}

shinyApp(ui, server)
} # }
